title:
Prepares the chart config spec and fetches the chart config from {@link ModelCloningChartHelper}

Optional payload arguments:
- addSensor: string representing a sensor ID - the sensor related to this ID will be included in the chart
- removeSensor: string representing a sensor ID - the sensor related to this ID will be removed from the
                chart (if it was plotted before)
- plotAllIncludedSensors: boolean - when true, all "Included" sensors will be plotted and all other sensors
                will be removed from the chart
